supports: A path to citizenship for Dreamers, TPS holders, farmworkers and essential workers
Stronger protections for asylum seekers and refugees
positions.quote: I support comprehensive immigration reform that includes a path to citizenship for Dreamers, Temporary Protected Status (TPS) holders, farmworkers, and essential workers; stronger protections for asylum seekers and refugees; and modernized visa systems that reflect our economic needs and humanitarian values.

source.title: Immigration | Congressman Gregory Meeks (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: Millions of long-term residents without permanent status could become eligible for citizenship. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

positions.quote: Access to healthcare is a human right, not a privilege.

source.title: Health | Congressman Gregory Meeks (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: He would vote to expand public health coverage. The page doesn't name specific bills.

supports: Closing racial and gender wage gaps through labor protections
positions.quote: They help close racial and gender wage gaps, ensure that work is met with respect, and build a pathway to the American Dream, especially for those historically shut out.

source.title: Labor | Congressman Gregory Meeks (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: Expect support for union and labor-protection bills. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.
